court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before M.M. Sundresh and Teekaa Raman, JJ.)
respondents: Additional Director General of Police and Another .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. R. Prathap Kumar, Additional Public Prosecutor
judgment_text:
Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a Writ of Habeas Corpus, directing the respondents to grant leave for 10 days to husband of the petitioner, the life convict-Sridhar, aged 32 years, son of Perumal, Prisoner No. 2533 who is now confined in Central Prison-I, Puzhal, Chennai to attend his father's 15 day death ceremony to be held on 14.09.2019 and 15.09.2019 at No. 2407, Ayyanar Street, Sivanthi Adithanar Nagar, Redhills, Chennai - 600 052.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

M.M. Sundresh, J.:— The petitioner is the wife of the convict, who has been under incarceration for having committed offence under Section 302 IPC. Seeking a direction to the respondents for grant of leave for 10 days, on the premise that 15th day death ceremony is to be performed for the recently deceased father of the life convict, the present petition has been filed.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the convict has been under incarceration for the period of more than 10 years. Therefore, appropriate orders will have to be passed.

3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that though the fact is not in dispute, the authorities have considered Emergency Leave only for 3 days.

4. We find that the convict will have to be given 5 days of ordinary leave inasmuch as the purpose for leave is not in dispute.

5. Accordingly, we direct the respondents to grant ordinary leave to the convict for 5 days subject to the usual conditions that can be imposed by the respondents. The convict shall be released from the prison at 10.00 a.m. on 13.09.2019 and that the convict shall return back to the prison at 05.00 p.m. on 19.09.2019. We make it clear that the day on which the convict is released from the prison and the day on which he is readmitted will have to be excluded from the leave.

6. In the result, the Habeas Corpus Petition is disposed of with the above directions.

7. List this matter on 23.09.2019 for reporting compliance.
